feature.name: ShadowMux: Off-Screen Lease & Conflict Sentinel
feature.summary: An autonomous agent acquires an atomic SQLite domain lease, mirrors Chrome cookies into an off-screen viewport at (-3200,-3200), pauses cleanly if the human touches the same domain, and stamps an audit receipt.

Releases SQLite lease & writes SHA-256 audit log

hypotheses.text: At least 85% of invoked ShadowMux sessions complete without blocking or error.
When human conflict occurs, at least 80% of sessions resume cleanly through arbitration.
Median session time stays under 60 seconds.

sessions.persona: Aravind, systems engineer running JobPilot + coding in VS Code (User 0)
sessions.context: desktop, macos, good network, no_conflict, keychain_cookie_access, chrome_extension_installed
sessions.goal: Let JobPilot submit a Greenhouse application silently while he stays in his IDE

moments.thought: Zero window flicker—VS Code never lost focus while Chrome worked at (-3200,-3200).
Got the confirmation hash in 38s without touching my mouse.

sessions.quote: Completely invisible—exactly how background browser automation should behave.

sessions.persona: Meera, Product Manager drafting in Gmail while agent runs (User 2)
sessions.context: desktop, linux, good network, same_domain_active, keychain_cookie_access, chrome_extension_installed
sessions.goal: Reply to an email without the agent overwriting her draft

moments.thought: A small corner pill said ShadowMux paused while I typed in Gmail. My cursor didn't jump.
Had to remember to click Resume on the pill after I sent the email.

sessions.quote: Saved my draft, though I almost forgot to unpause it afterwards.
sessions.unmet_need: Auto-resume once I close the tab or leave the domain.

sessions.context: desktop, macos, good network, same_domain_active, lacks keychain_cookie_access and extension
sessions.goal: Run his first background browser task

moments.thought: macOS popped up a Keychain access prompt for 'Chrome Safe Storage' with no context. I clicked Deny, and ShadowMux stopped cold.

sessions.quote: Why is a CLI tool suddenly asking for my Chrome Keychain password?
sessions.unmet_need: Explain the Keychain prompt beforehand and offer a clean unauthenticated/login fallback if denied.

sessions.context: desktop, macos, good network, same_domain_active, chrome_extension_installed, lacks keychain_cookie_access

sessions.persona: Naina, busy PM interrupted during a meeting (User 50)

sessions.context: desktop, linux, good network, no_conflict, keychain_cookie_access, chrome_extension_installed

moments.thought: Task finished, then lease release failed on a transient SQLite busy error—now the domain stays locked for 120s.

themes.title: Mandatory OS Keychain cookie cloning blocks both newcomers and public-site tasks
themes.evidence: Kabir (denied scary macOS Keychain prompt) and Riya (public Greenhouse form) both stalled at sync_cookies (36% of starters blocked).
themes.recommendation: Explain the Keychain prompt before triggering it, and allow ephemeral/unauthenticated shadow profiles when Keychain access is absent or unneeded.

themes.title: Conflict Sentinel depends on an unverified Chrome extension prerequisite
themes.evidence: Siddharth had not installed the Chrome extension, stalling conflict_sentinel_pause when he opened the same domain.
themes.recommendation: Check extension presence at setup and fall back to OS window-title / CDP target polling if the extension is missing.

themes.title: Manual 'Resume' pill gets lost during real multitasking
themes.evidence: Naina got pulled into a meeting and never clicked Resume before the lease TTL expired; Meera nearly forgot too.
themes.recommendation: Auto-resume 5–10 seconds after the human switches away from the conflicted domain, and show TTL countdown on the pill.

spec_gaps.title: Keychain denial / Linux keyring failure fallback is missing
spec_gaps.detail: Proposal Section 2.4 decrypts Cookies via OS Keychain APIs, but does not define what happens when the user clicks Deny or runs headless Linux.

spec_gaps.title: Paused agent timeout vs resume behavior
spec_gaps.detail: When Conflict Sentinel sets PAUSED_FOR_HUMAN, the spec says lease TTL is 120s—if the human takes >120s on their tab, does the stale lock scavenger kill the paused checkpoint?

spec_gaps.title: Multi-monitor negative coordinates collision
spec_gaps.detail: If a user arranges an external monitor to the top-left of their primary display in macOS Displays, (-3200, -3200) can land on a visible monitor or snap back on-screen.
